title: Capture byte budgets
responsibility: Streams capture bytes into a digest, reports per-file limit failures, and accounts for bytes admitted to one verification record.

inputs.name: digestFile.path
inputs.description: File path opened without following a final-component symlink and checked to be a regular file.

inputs.name: digestFile.maxBytes
inputs.description: Optional byte ceiling enforced during streaming; exceeding it throws before the extra chunk is retained.

inputs.name: digestFile.retain
inputs.description: When true, also return the bytes read in contents; defaults to false.

inputs.name: oversizeCapture.file
inputs.description: Capture filename used in the refusal message.

inputs.name: oversizeCapture.bytes
inputs.description: Observed capture byte size.

inputs.name: oversizeCapture.limits
inputs.description: Optional per-capture and per-record limits used to form the refusal.

inputs.name: RecordBudget.constructor.max
inputs.description: Optional total bytes this record may retain.

inputs.name: RecordBudget.refusal.path
inputs.description: Record-relative capture path used in the refusal message.

inputs.name: RecordBudget.refusal.bytes
inputs.description: Observed capture byte size to add to the bytes already retained.

inputs.name: RecordBudget.retain.bytes
inputs.description: Bytes successfully inspected and admitted to the record.

outputs.name: digestFile
outputs.description: SHA-256 and byte count, with optional contents when retain is true.

outputs.name: oversizeCapture
outputs.description: Refusal text when a capture exceeds maxCaptureBytes, otherwise undefined.

outputs.name: RecordBudget.remaining
outputs.description: Remaining record bytes, or undefined when no record cap exists.

outputs.name: RecordBudget.refusal
outputs.description: Refusal text when the capture would exceed the record cap, otherwise undefined.

outputs.name: RecordBudget.retain
outputs.description: Adds the admitted capture byte count to the record budget.

errors.name: Capture read failure
errors.description: digestFile rejects when the path cannot be opened/read, is not a regular file, or resolves to a final-component symlink
examples: Capture must be a regular file.

errors.name: Capture byte limit exceeded
errors.description: digestFile rejects when streamed bytes exceed maxBytes
examples: Capture exceeded maxCaptureBytes or remaining maxRecordBytes while reading.
